heading: Optimize flow with empowering creators to realize they can monetize their creations at the early steps.

blocks.html: After a thorough benchmarking analysis, I gained new insights into strategies for character creation. My goal is to make creators feel the creation process both easy and motivating, encouraging them to engage and invest effort willingly.
🤩 MOTIVATE CREATOR FIRST: Place the character pricing page early motivates creators by highlighting earning potential, encouraging more effort in creating quality characters.
🥳 POSITIVE FEEDBACK: Provide inspiring animations after creators complete the character creation, to encourage to go for the advanced character settings.
After syncing up with the PM and reassessing during our team's internal review, I advanced the flow iteration and got the team on board with the proposal.

blocks.alt: Conch Ai — Optimize flow with empowering creators to realize they can monetize their creations at the early steps.
